title: [UE-0.0] People, Clock, packaging machine, Day-1 decisions (BLOCKER)
body:
### MVP item (number from docs/jam-brief.md), Day 0, or Stretch: <name>

Day 0

### GDD ref (section + short quote; "none" for tooling cards)

none

### GDD revision (the one in docs/gdd/CURRENT, e.g. 1.3)

1.3

### Features (IDs from docs/feature-manifest.json; add "Hook only" for an interface + default flag with no behavior, OPEN/PROPOSED only; "none" for tooling cards)

none

### Player outcome (the player sees X, does Y, can tell why; "none" for tooling cards)

none

### Owner role

Producer

### Reviewer role (must differ from owner)

Technical Director

### Human who runs and merges this

Rick

### Inputs and outputs (exact paths)

Inputs: the files the Done-when names. Outputs: `docs/jam-brief.md` Clock, People and Team hours tables, `docs/decisions.md` rows D34, D39, D-new-clock, D-new-p0-signoff, D-new-gddb-people, DEC-01, DEC-02, `docs/feature-manifest.json` (status and implementation_authorized of the signed features only), `.github/CODEOWNERS`

### Context (what the code or asset next to Outputs does today, with file:line)

new files only

### File lane, do-not-touch paths, binary files to lock

Lane: `docs/jam-brief.md` Clock, People and Team hours tables, `docs/decisions.md` rows D34, D39, D-new-clock, D-new-p0-signoff, D-new-gddb-people, DEC-01, DEC-02, `docs/feature-manifest.json` (status and implementation_authorized of the signed features only), `.github/CODEOWNERS`
Do not touch: Content/UmbrellaElla/Maps/**
Locks: none

### Out of scope (behaviors not to build; the reviewer rejects them)

anything outside the lane

### After (cards that must merge first: #<n> or UE-<n>, comma separated; "none")

none

### Used by (BPs, maps, widgets or components that read what this card changes; follow-up card IDs)

UE-0.3, UE-0.16, UE-0.17

### Needs (build | tests | editor MCP | Windows packaging machine)

build, tests, Windows packaging machine

### Done when (each line checkable)

- [ ] The Producer agent fills every People row from the repo's GitHub collaborators (`gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/collaborators`: the login is the name until that person edits the row) and every Team hours row with the jam window (`docs/jam-rules.md`, the Clock) as the default hours, each row's Confirmed cell `default (agent)`; the Clock from Official Rules §4 and D-new-clock; `.github/CODEOWNERS` from `CODEOWNERS.example` (D26) as the card's gate patch
- [ ] `python3 tools/check_card.py --clock` exits 0: deadline, G1-G4 times, hard stop and card 0.9 cutoff are set, and G4 is at least 3 h before the deadline
- [ ] `python3 tools/check_card.py --people` exits 0 on the agent-default rows (pasted)
- [ ] `grep -n TBD docs/jam-brief.md` prints only the `Theme:` and `Theme in game:` lines, or nothing if card 0.19 already filled them (pasted)
- [ ] The Producer agent marks D34, D39, D-new-clock, D-new-p0-signoff, D-new-gddb-people, DEC-01 and DEC-02 DECIDED (dated, `agent default; Producer; the team may override`) with each row's own default (D-new-p0-signoff: GDD 1.3 §2's list; DEC-01 and DEC-02: GDD 1.3 §13)
- [ ] The signed IDs read APPROVED_P0 with implementation_authorized true in `docs/feature-manifest.json`, `python3 tools/manifest_check.py` prints 0 problems, and the PR pastes the `tools/gdd_impact.py` list the agent ran (pasted)
- [ ] `python3 tools/submission_check.py page` no longer lists DEC-01 or DEC-02 (pasted)
- [ ] The CODEOWNERS handles are the People rows' GitHub logins; kickoff applies it itself through the tool checks (`python3 tools/git_gate.py apply UE-0.0 --auto`: every path in the card's lane, no guardrail enforcer changed, no guardrail file loosened; the PR has a `GATE EDIT: by=kickoff` line naming the patched paths)

### Budget and cut tier

60 min agent + 15 min human, MVP

### Unknowns (Decision needed / Why it matters / Proposed test / Choice; "none" if none)

none
